Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.5992 Of 2024
Order:

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to declare the action of the respondents in opening rowdy sheet against him as being arbitrary and violative of Articles 14 and 21 of the Indian Constitution.

2. The case of the petitioner is that a rowdy sheet was illegally and arbitrarily opened against him on the basis of a solitary case in Crime No.37 of 2018 of Marredpally Police Station registered against him.

Police have filed charge sheet in the said case and the petitioner was tried in Sessions Case PCS.No.97 of 2018 on the file of the Special Sessions Judge for Trial of Cases under Rape and Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, for the offences under Section 3 read with Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Sections 366 and 376(1) IPC and Section 3 (2) (va) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989 and after trial, the matter ended in acquittal vide judgment dated 14.03.2022.

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that except the above solitary case, there is no other case pending against the petitioner.

4. Mr. G. Aniketh Reddy, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home, submitted that the petitioner was involved in heinous offence and in order to keep surveillance over his activities,
rowdy sheet was opened against him.
5.

As seen from the contents of the counter affidavit filed by respondent No.4, the petitioner was involved in Crime No.37 of 2018 of Marredpally Police Station, wherein he was tried in Sessions Case PCS.No.97 of 2018 and the same ended in acquittal.
The petitioner was involved in only one case and the same ended in acquittal
and as on today, there is no case pending against him.

Thus,
continuance of rowdy sheet against the petitioner is illegal and violative of Article 21 of the Indian Constitution.
6. Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed.
The respondents are directed to forthwith close rowdy sheet opened against the petitioner.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in the writ petition stand closed.
